paper_id: An Explainable Toolbox for Evaluating Pre-trained Vision-Language Models
title: An Explainable Toolbox for Evaluating Pre-trained Vision-Language Models
motivation: 现有VLP评估只看下游任务平均准确率，无法洞察模型优缺点，难测corner case
problem_framing: 用ITM任务探测模型鲁棒性，通过语言/视觉扰动生成hard negatives进行细粒度分析
key_insight: minor input changes会暴露模型能力边界，hard negative采样策略是诊断的核心
method_signature: VL-CheckList: 语言变体(Object/Attribute/Relation)+视觉变体(object-level augmentation)
evaluation_criteria: accuracy = 正样本分数>负样本分数的比例 (Equation 1)
negative_result_or_admitted_limitation: CLIP对属性和关系变体理解能力极低，尤其Relation-spatial；小目标和角落目标识别受限
evidence_for_taste: only average downstream task accuracy provides little information
test models' robustness against extreme corner cases
revealed weaknesses in several state-of-the-art NLP models
explore more fine-grained region-to-text multimodal alignment is a promising direction
the location and size of the object can significantly affect the judgment
thinking_moves: 从黑盒准确率反推具体能力缺陷
把评估问题转化为诊断探测问题
用扰动实验揭示模型注意力分布偏好
extraction_notes: 论文提供了完整的动机、问题定义、方法论和实验结果，提取质量为full
